verdict.rationale: No evidence pack items discuss Discord's free-tier message history limits or retention policies; nothing addresses whether older messages remain accessible on free servers without upgrading to Nitro/paid tiers. This axis is plausible for Discord (a freemium chat platform), but absence of documentation or community evidence on message history retention means the claim is unsupported. Missing for 10: any documentation of message history limits, retention windows, or search restrictions tied to free vs paid tiers.
